payloadSchema.description:
Request parameters for listing existing sessions.

Only available if the Agent supports the `sessionCapabilities.list` capability.

_meta.description:
The _meta property is reserved by ACP to allow clients and agents to attach additional
metadata to their interactions. Implementations MUST NOT make assumptions about values at
these keys.

See protocol docs: [Extensibility](https://agentclientprotocol.com/protocol/extensibility)

additionalDirectories.description:
**UNSTABLE**

This capability is not part of the spec yet, and may be removed or changed at any point.

Filter sessions by the exact ordered additional workspace roots. Each path must be absolute.

This filter applies only when the field is present and non-empty. When
omitted or empty, no additional-root filter is applied.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor token from a previous response's nextCursor field for cursor-based pagination

cwd.description: Filter sessions by working directory. Must be an absolute path.

SessionInfo.description: Information about a session returned by session/list

_meta.description:
The _meta property is reserved by ACP to allow clients and agents to attach additional
metadata to their interactions. Implementations MUST NOT make assumptions about values at
these keys.

See protocol docs: [Extensibility](https://agentclientprotocol.com/protocol/extensibility)

additionalDirectories.description:
**UNSTABLE**

This capability is not part of the spec yet, and may be removed or changed at any point.

Authoritative ordered additional workspace roots for this session. Each path must be absolute.

When omitted or empty, there are no additional roots for the session.

cwd.description: The working directory for this session. Must be an absolute path.

SessionId.description:
A unique identifier for a conversation session between a client and agent.

Sessions maintain their own context, conversation history, and state,
allowing multiple independent interactions with the same agent.

See protocol docs: [Session ID](https://agentclientprotocol.com/protocol/session-setup#session-id)

_meta.description:
The _meta property is reserved by ACP to allow clients and agents to attach additional
metadata to their interactions. Implementations MUST NOT make assumptions about values at
these keys.

See protocol docs: [Extensibility](https://agentclientprotocol.com/protocol/extensibility)

nextCursor.description:
Opaque cursor token. If present, pass this in the next request's cursor parameter
to fetch the next page. If absent, there are no more results.

limitations: Exact ACP schema 0.11.4 (v0.11.4, e9313572), the dependency of the nearest public Grok mirror commit. The binary embeds agent-client-protocol-0.10.4 (binary probe), and every captured 1.0.70 carrier validates against it; the schema is not the binary's own source.

The result schema is allOf(exact ACP, sampled Grok 1.0.70 instance): the sampled branch records Grok's observed extension fields. Sampled from the Grok 1.0.70 darwin-arm64 census: observed JSON types per field, with required fields present in every captured instance. Sanitized strings keep their type but not their value, so enumerations and formats are not inferred.
The carrier fixes the JSON-RPC envelope and method; params are validated by the payload schema.

notes: Advertised through sessionCapabilities.list; sessions carry `_meta["x.ai/session"]` facets.
